description: Client-side script for managing the 'Payroll Entry' form in ERPNext, including functions for loading, filtering, creating salary slips, handling employee data, and related UI actions.

methods.name: submit_salary_slip
methods.description: Confirms and submits salary slips, creating an accrual journal entry.

methods.name: make_bank_entry
methods.description: Creates a bank payment entry if a payment account is specified.

methods.name: render_employee_attendance
methods.description: Renders the employee attendance data into HTML using a template.
